title: Alone
description: You're completely alone in this world, right?
body:
You're completely alone in this world, right?

This mod adds a new horror events that you should pass completely alone...or not?
NOTE: This mod disables all the mobs spawn including mobs from the other mods
This mod trying not to kill you but make your life harder adding new bad events
If you think it's not enough spawn rate of the Friend you can change it with this command:
/friendchanceset <number>
Reccomended numbers are from 0.0001 to 1

Subscribe on mod's platforms:

Discord Server

YouTube

Telegram channel

Wiki

VK (Russian) 

 

If you're made a video with my mod you can let me know, I'd like to see it :D

 

There's all the events description, contains spoilers: 

1. All the mobs despawns, including mobs from the other mods

2. Friend can join the game

3. Mind and Soul mechanic. Mind and Soul constantly grows making Friend spawn more
4. New Friend mob that chases and attacks you 

5. Pills that can decrease Mind a Soul a bit
6. Water. If Friend gets into water it'll be breaking water blocks as well as player
7. Diamonds. Sometimes Friend can go to look at your treasures
8. Friend can learn how to break the blocks
9. I should gourd my eye. Sometimes Friend can force you to lose your mind and wanting to gourd your eye

10. You can gourd one of your eye and if you do so you won't see a half of your display

11. If you gourd both of your eyes Friend will gift you a one new eye to see
12. Knife. If you gourd your eye you'll get a knife with a good damage
